cheats.name: Skip server authentication and license check
cheats.description: 놈 ZERO is a paid title guarded by two gates: the Gamevil server auth check and a local DRM license check that reads platform files (cf.dat/app.dat/admin.dat) the retired LGT store would have installed. Both patches force the game onto its unprotected boot path so it reaches the menu.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: return 0x10, the already-authenticated result, from the authentication check
return 0 from the license-protected probe so the loader takes the unprotected init path instead of the DRM error screen
